analysis.title_zh: Managed Deep Agents v0.8：用户身份、记忆与 HTTP 通道
analysis.summary: v0.8 增加用户级凭证和记忆、HTTP 通道、Slack 文件传输及内置网络搜索，用于把智能体接入实际产品和工作流程。
analysis.application: 建议：多人共享的科研助手可先检查权限和记忆是否按用户隔离，再接入团队工具。
analysis.requirements: 适用于 Managed Deep Agents v0.8；部署、账户和计费条件见官方文档。
evidence: Identity-scoped auth and memory: user-owned credentials and user-level memory let agents act on the right permissions and remember caller-specific context.
HTTP channels: use agents in internal tools, customer portals, support systems, and other product surfaces that can send webhooks.
